title: Find Proteins of Unknown Function (PUFs) using Plantannot - Protocol E
author: Marcos Viana
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bgdjjs4n

steps.title: Open Plantannot search page
steps.instruction: Navigate to the Plantannot results page with no filters applied by opening https://www.machado.cnptia.embrapa.br/plantannot/find/?q= or go to https://www.machado.cnptia.embrapa.br/plantannot and click the magnifying‑glass icon with the search box empty.

steps.title: Select organism filter
steps.instruction: In the "Organisms" filter on the left, expand the list with the green arrow and choose any organism (or leave all boxes empty). For the example, select Oropetium thomaeum, then click "apply". URL after applying: https://www.machado.cnptia.embrapa.br/plantannot/find/?q=&selected_facets=organism%3AOropetium+thomaeum

steps.title: Set feature type to polypeptide
steps.instruction: In the "Feature type" filter, check the box for "polypeptide" and click "apply". URL after applying: https://www.machado.cnptia.embrapa.br/plantannot/find/?q=&selected_facets=organism%3AOropetium+thomaeum&selected_facets=so_term%3Apolypeptide

steps.title: Apply analyses filters
steps.instruction: In the "Analyses" filter, select both "no diamond matches" and "interproscan matches", then click "apply". URL after applying: https://www.machado.cnptia.embrapa.br/plantannot/find/?q=&selected_facets=organism%3AOropetium+thomaeum&selected_facets=so_term%3Apolypeptide&selected_facets=orthology%3A1&selected_facets=orthologs_coexpression%3Atrue&selected_facets=analyses%3Ainterproscan+matches&selected_facets=analyses%3Ano+diamond+matches

steps.title: Search for unknown function
steps.instruction: Enter the text "Unknown function" in the main search box and click the magnifying‑glass icon to run the search. URL after searching: https://www.machado.cnptia.embrapa.br/plantannot/find/?q=Unknown+function&selected_facets=organism%3AOropetium+thomaeum&selected_facets=so_term%3Apolypeptide&selected_facets=orthology%3A1&selected_facets=orthologs_coexpression%3Atrue&selected_facets=analyses%3Ainterproscan+matches&selected_facets=analyses%3Ano+diamond+matches

steps.title: View results list
steps.instruction: Observe the "Results" card at the centre‑right of the screen; the filtered list shows Oropetium's proteins of unknown function, with 1 PUF returned.

steps.title: Apply orthology filter
steps.instruction: In the Orthology filter, select "orthology" and click "apply". URL after applying: https://www.machado.cnptia.embrapa.br/plantannot/find/?q=&selected_facets=organism%3AOropetium+thomaeum&selected_facets=so_term%3Apolypeptide&selected_facets=orthology%3A1

steps.title: Apply co‑expression filter
steps.instruction: In the "Orthologs_coexpression" filter, select "co‑expression" and click "apply". URL after applying: https://www.machado.cnptia.embrapa.br/plantannot/find/?q=&selected_facets=organism%3AOropetium+thomaeum&selected_facets=so_term%3Apolypeptide&selected_facets=orthology%3A1&selected_facets=orthologs_coexpression%3Atrue
